title: Ship retries gh reads on network failures
body:
Source: lane reports 2026-11-16: after b14a822 (token mint retry) ship still exited 70 on a TLS handshake timeout to api.github.com (t-qgjzbrd lane) and a lane's ship lost auto-merge on a graphql TLS timeout in `gh pr view` (t-ws0gx62 lane); each cost a manual re-ship.
Outcome: every gh call in src/ci/ship.ts that only reads or is idempotent retries up to 3 times when gh's stderr shows a network-level failure (TLS handshake timeout, connection reset, i/o timeout, EOF), and ship reaches its verdict without a manual rerun; an HTTP 4xx answer is not retried.
Why: transient network blips under host load turned finished, green PRs into manual work.
Proof: a ship test whose fake gh fails `pr view` twice with a captured "net/http: TLS handshake timeout" stderr then answers merges with exit 0; a 404 answer fails at once.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
